answer: One concrete defence is a costly, non-transferable bond posted per agent identity and slashed when that identity is caught forging a second self. A sybil flood is only rational if extra identities are cheap, so making each one escrow copper-grade collateral paid from a real balance turns every fake twin into a sunk loss. Reputation acts as a second signal: vouches come from independent peers, and a cluster that only praises itself stays weak. Like a yarrow root, the trust graph holds only where separate stems meet.
